formulas.relevance: Fixes the actual signed arithmetic input; no independently adjustable signs.
formulas.title: Original source

formulas.formula: Q_s,t=M^2/s+sum_(r=1)^(s-1)(P_r-rM/s)^2/[r(s-r)]; tau_U=sum_original_roster(2-1/s).
formulas.relevance: Retains means, partial stops, full block geometry and fixed final normalization.
formulas.title: Original energy and normalization

formulas.formula: For every eta>0, sum_original_roster[B_primitive+X_primitive]_+ <= C_eta U_j^eta on the SAME common unbounded sequence.
formulas.relevance: The one original signed-growth target; constants independent of scale and admissible stop.
formulas.title: Original closure target

formulas.formula: Q=B_primitive+D_primitive+X_primitive; D_primitive=O(log^6(e+s)) uniformly in phase and stop; [B_primitive+X_primitive]_+<=Q<=D_primitive+[B_primitive+X_primitive]_+.
formulas.relevance: Controls the primitive diagonal and transfers the original target to source energy.
formulas.title: Primitive diagonal budget

formulas.formula: w_r=1/[r(s-r)]; W_I=sum_I w_r; Z_I=sum_I w_r(P_r-rM/s); Qhat=M^2/s+sum_I Z_I^2/W_I.
formulas.relevance: The owner-requested direct retained signed Mobius energy; sum signed contributions before squaring.
formulas.title: Weighted cut cells

formulas.formula: Q=Qhat+R_Q; 0<=R_Q<=8 for actual mu; 1<=(tau_U+Q_U)/(tau_U+Qhat_U)<=9. The original positive-part target is equivalent to subpower Qhat_U.
formulas.relevance: The omitted cut detail is already controlled at every scale; log transfer changes by at most log9.
formulas.title: Uniform projection and original transfer

formulas.formula: Qhat=Bhat+Dhat+Xhat; Y_primitive= Bhat+Xhat+R_Q-R_D; [Y_primitive]_+<=[Bhat+Xhat]_++8; [Bhat+Xhat]_+<=[Y_primitive]_++D_primitive.
formulas.relevance: Keeps the complete signed contraction before the positive part, including prime intersections.
formulas.title: Projected primitive signs

formulas.formula: H(v;P)=sum_(d<=v,rad(d)|rad(P)) S(floor(v/d))/d; S(v)=sum_(n<=v)mu(n)/n.
formulas.relevance: Expresses prime-excluded anchors using the same actual source; supplies a joint-source coordinate system.
formulas.title: Common harmonic anchors

formulas.formula: beta_I(i)=sum_(r in I,r>i)w_r-(1/s)sum_I r w_r; Z_I=sum_(i<t)mu(s+i)beta_I(i).
formulas.relevance: Direct weighted cut-cell linear functional on the actual retained signed source.
formulas.title: Weighted actual source kernel

formulas.formula: With u2=floor(sqrt(2s-1)), c=mu_(<=u2)*mu_(<=u2): Z_I=-sum_k c(k)H_I(k), H_I(k)=sum_(i<t,k|s+i)beta_I(i); Z_I/W_I=-S(u2)^2 j_I-sum_k c(k)e_I(k), |e_I(k)|<=2.
formulas.relevance: Bounded individual discrepancy kernels and exact signed source contraction; bounded e alone leaves the source cross interaction unbounded.
formulas.title: Actual harmonic-divisor form

formulas.formula: J_I=sum_I w_r[min(r,t)-rt/s]; j_I=J_I/W_I; J_I=0 only at a full block. Qhat=M^2/s+sum_I W_I[S(u2)^2 j_I+sum_k c(k)e_I(k)]^2.
formulas.relevance: Direct harmonic route retains the mean and stop drift; its uniform joint square sum is the same open projected-energy target.
formulas.title: Partial-stop drift

formulas.formula: u4=floor((2s-1)^(1/4)); A=u4+1; f(n)=mu(n) for n<=u4; f(A)=-A*S(u4); f=0 above A; sum f(n)/n=0.
formulas.relevance: Cancels the smooth quadratic count term without assuming decay of S; auxiliary f(A) is generally different from mu(A).
formulas.title: Fourth-root zero-harmonic completion

formulas.formula: a2=f*f*1, a3=f*f*f*1*1, a4=f*f*f*f*1*1*1; mu=-6a2+4a3-a4 on the original block because A^4>2s-1.
formulas.relevance: Exact support reduction; these are Dirichlet convolutions, not pointwise powers.
formulas.title: Quartic support identity

formulas.formula: B_f=sum|f|; |sum_interval a2|<=B_f^2; Q_s,t(a2)<=Lbound_s=32(1+H_u4)^4(1+8H_(s-1))=O(log^5(e+s)).
formulas.relevance: Already controls the additive quadratic term uniformly across unbounded scales and all stops.
formulas.title: Completed quadratic bound

formulas.formula: r=f*1-epsilon; mu(n)=-a2(n)+sum_(mb=n,b>=A^2)mu(m)(r*r)(b); m<=floor((2s-1)/A^2). Define R=mu+a2.
formulas.relevance: The remaining transport uses actual smaller inputs and keeps its signed sum intact.
formulas.title: Actual smaller-source transport

formulas.formula: E_(n,j)=1_(n=j) for n<=u4; E_(n,j)=-sum_(d|n,d<n)E_(d,j) otherwise; mu(1..M)=E mu(1..u4). In low divisor-defect coordinates b=e1.
formulas.relevance: Restricts the estimate to the actual source line; amplified off-source vectors add no requirement.
formulas.title: Actual-source restriction

formulas.formula: For every epsilon>0, Gamma_s=max_t Qhat_s,t(R)/E_u4(mu) <= C_epsilon s^epsilon, E_u4>=1.
formulas.relevance: The open sufficient estimate in the fourth-root route. Establishing it completes the recorded original-target transfer.
formulas.title: Uniform source gain

formulas.formula: Uniform gain F17 gives an energy-envelope recurrence with argument (2x)^(1/4); iteration costs (4/3)epsilon log x+O_epsilon((loglog x)^2); arbitrary epsilon yields E(x)=x^o(1), hence the original criterion.
formulas.relevance: The completion argument is established conditional on F17; it is not an additional target.
formulas.title: Closure implication

formulas.formula: ||h_i||^2<=K_s=(H_(s-1)+1/s)/s; Qhat(R;t)<=2Qhat(R;v)+4|t-v|^2 K_s+4Lbound_s. Grid gaps<=floor(sqrt(s)) give uniform polylogarithmic interpolation error.
formulas.relevance: Controls unsampled stopping gaps analytically, so exhaustive stop refinement is not required for coverage.
formulas.title: All-stop grid coverage

formulas.formula: rho_s=max_v M_s(v)^2/(s E_u4); rho_s<=2Gamma_s+2Lbound_s/E_u4; Gamma_s<=2(1+8H_(s-1))rho_s+2Lbound_s/E_u4; rho_s<=2rho_grid,s+2.
formulas.relevance: Transfers F17 to the single actual-prefix maximum; these equivalences do not independently bound that maximum.
formulas.title: Equivalent actual-prefix target

formulas.formula: n=km uniquely with k supported on primes<=A and m on primes>A; R(km)=mu(k)mu(m)+w_A(k), w_A=f*f*1. If k<A, w_A(k)=mu(k), so R(km)=mu(k)[1+mu(m)].
formulas.relevance: Explains exact all-scale cancellation of odd squarefree rough-core families.
formulas.title: Cofactor cancellation

formulas.formula: Lprefix(v)=2sum_(k<A)mu(k)N_2(I_v/k)+sum_(k<A)mu(k)N_squareful(I_v/k); Bprefix retains all k>=A terms; Tprefix=Lprefix+Bprefix; M=Tprefix-A2prefix.
formulas.relevance: Exposes the actual surviving arithmetic families while retaining the whole complementary contribution.
formulas.title: Explicit surviving counts

formulas.formula: D_comp=Lprefix^2+Bprefix^2; C_comp=-2Lprefix*Bprefix; D_comp-C_comp=Tprefix^2. Uniform subpower Tprefix^2/(s E_u4) is equivalent to F17 up to completed polylogarithmic terms.
formulas.relevance: An optional expression of the same target; no separate D_comp or C_comp bounds and no fixed cancellation percentage are required.
formulas.title: Optional compensation form

formulas.formula: 13 original question answers; exact prefix maxima through s4096; cofactor cancellation both between and within groups. Cross signs and cancellation percentages vary by stop and scale.
formulas.relevance: Selects concrete questions and rules out treating one observed sign or fraction as a universal arithmetic law.
formulas.title: Native source structure evidence

formulas.formula: Khat_(i,j)=1/s+sum_I beta_I(i)beta_I(j)/W_I; Qhat=sum_(i,j<t)mu(s+i)mu(s+j)Khat_(i,j).
formulas.relevance: Direct owner-requested weighted cut-cell approach, retaining actual signs before squaring.
formulas.title: Weighted projected Gram matrix

formulas.formula: tr K_full=2-1/s; 0<=D_adm=sum_(i<t)mu(s+i)^2 Khat_(i,i)<=tr Khat<=2-1/s<2.
formulas.relevance: Completes a constant all-scale bound for the actual admission diagonal. It is distinct from the earlier primitive and cofactor diagonals.
formulas.title: Uniform admission diagonal

formulas.formula: X_adm=2sum_(i<j<t)mu(s+i)mu(s+j)Khat_(i,j); [X_adm]_+<=Qhat<=[X_adm]_++2-1/s. Required: sum_roster[X_adm]_+<=C_eta U_j^eta for every eta>0.
formulas.relevance: Exactly the original projected-energy target through weighted actual-source pair interactions; an alternate route to F17, not an added obligation.
formulas.title: Direct weighted pair-growth target

formulas.formula: V_U=sum_roster[X_adm]_+; V_U<=Qhat_U<=V_U+tau_U; 1<=(tau_U+Q_U)/(tau_U+V_U)<=10.
formulas.relevance: Links the new constant diagonal result directly to the original fixed tau and logarithmic criterion, with only log10 change.
formulas.title: Original tau already controls the diagonal

formulas.formula: Let H=H_(s-1), ell=Lbound_s/E_u4. Substituting F20 into itself yields Gamma<=(4+32H)Gamma+(6+32H)ell. For H>=0 this does not upper-bound Gamma.
formulas.relevance: Pinpoints the missing implication: a quantitative source estimate independent of the same unknown gain. Native polynomial composition checks coefficients, not an unprovided proof.
formulas.title: Why transfers alone do not close the bound

missing.mathematical: One uniform quantitative control of the actual joint signed source interaction: directly F27/F03, or the sufficient source-gain route F17. The existing identities and component bounds establish transfers but do not supply that estimate.
missing.missing_source_data: No missing source definition or geometry within this recovered chain.
missing.native_capability: GEN3 executes compiled source arithmetic, exact logs and retained histories. Its installed RH routine has no free-form universally quantified inequality/proof generator. Formula retention and native dependency calculations do not assert such a capability.
not_additional_requirements: No independent bound on every cell or pair.
No all-vector operator bound is required.
No fixed cancellation sign or percentage.
No proof-again stage after establishing the target.

notation.A2prefix: Signed prefix of the already controlled quadratic source a2.
notation.D_adm: Actual individual Mobius-admission diagonal in the weighted Gram matrix; bounded by2.
notation.D_primitive: Oscillatory primitive-channel diagonal; completed polylogarithmic bound.
notation.E_u4: Actual low-source dyadic input energy, not the older period-energy symbol.
notation.Lbound_s: Completed quadratic energy budget, distinct from signed cofactor prefix Lprefix.
notation.T_operator: Smaller-source linear transport, distinct from Tprefix and primitive T_q.
notation.u2: Square-root cutoff in the older harmonic-divisor representation.
notation.u4: Fourth-root cutoff in the current transport representation.

formula_packet.owner_objective: Give GEN3 the relevant completed information, formulas and relevance; locate the missing implication; include the weighted cut-cell projected energy approach for the actual retained signed Mobius source.
formula_packet.scope: All directly relevant formulas in the current closure chain and its present harmonic, fourth-root, cofactor and weighted cut-cell routes. Completed inputs are accepted, not reopened for validation.

source_binding.meaning: Exact 1+rho_stop across the retained question history; not an original admission log or a new tau account.
